BiblicalUsage: In Hebrew, sâchaṭ means to tread out, that is squeeze (grapes). It stands in Genesis 40:11: "…the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sâchaṭ is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
